name: to-cot-xml
expect: <event version="2.0" uid="12345" type="a-u-X"><point lat="48.2" lon="11.5" hae="9999999" ce="9999999" le="9999999"/><detail><track course="90" speed="5"/></detail></event>
reference: Input: vector 01 (asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper). uid "12345" from stationID by text_of; the cot-xml pack writes the constant version, uid, its default type a-u-X, the point with its defaults 9999999 for hae, ce and le, and detail/track course and speed; time, start, stale and how have no value and no default and are not written. Attributes in field-line order (0.1 canonicalisation). Derived without an engine.
